display.purpose: Hero H1 only, two lines maximum.

shadows.name: menu-panel
shadows.purpose: The only shadow: separates the mobile disclosure panel from the page.

shadows.name: header-veil
shadows.purpose: Sticky header legibility; dropped under prefers-reduced-transparency.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Entrance settle for reveal elements and the hero plate.

motion.name: reveal-fade
motion.purpose: Quiet fade-up driven by IntersectionObserver; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: hero-blur
motion.value: filter 0.85s ease from blur(7px) to blur(0)
motion.purpose: The single authored moment: the hero plate resolves from soft to sharp.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action: coral fill, ink label, 52px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:0 26px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius); font-family:var(--font); font-size:1.02rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.01em; background:var(--coral); color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--coral-hi); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--mint); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Honest coming-soon state. Never a control: dashed border, muted label, no link.
components.css: .ds-chip-soon { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:52px; padding:0 22px; border:1px dashed rgba(195,203,222,.45); border-radius:var(--radius); background:rgba(237,241,248,.03); color:var(--moon-dim); font-family:var(--font); font-size:.98rem; font-weight:500; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: Two 46x44 buttons; active state is coral with ink text, mirrored in aria-pressed.
components.css: .ds-lang { display:flex; gap:6px; } .ds-lang-btn { min-width:46px; min-height:44px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:var(--radius); background:transparent; color:var(--moon-dim); font-family:var(--font); font-size:.88rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .16s ease, color .16s ease; } .ds-lang-btn:hover { color:var(--moon); border-color:var(--mint); } .ds-lang-btn.is-active { background:var(--coral); border-color:var(--coral); color:var(--ink); } .ds-lang-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--mint); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Header and footer links: 44px hit area, quiet hover wash, no underline until hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 13px; border-radius:var(--radius); color:var(--moon-dim); font-family:var(--font); font-size:.95rem; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; transition:color .16s ease, background-color .16s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color:var(--moon); background:rgba(159,231,206,.09); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--mint); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Atlas Cell
components.description: Topic pillar cell: plate on top, title and copy below, flat with a hairline frame.
components.html:
Numerology

Life paths, repeating numbers and personal cycles.
components.css: .ds-atlas-cell { display:flex; flex-direction:column; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius); overflow:hidden; background:rgba(10,16,36,.55); } .ds-atlas-media { aspect-ratio:4/3; background:var(--cobalt-field); } .ds-atlas-body { padding:clamp(20px,2vw,28px); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; } .ds-atlas-body h3 { margin:0; font-family:var(--font); font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.02em; color:var(--moon); } .ds-atlas-body p { margin:0; font-family:var(--font); font-size:1rem; line-height:1.6; color:var(--moon-dim); }

components.name: Illustration Plate
components.description: Framed local SVG: 14px radius, hairline-strong border, cobalt backing, cover fit.
components.css: .ds-plate { border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:var(--radius); overflow:hidden; background:var(--cobalt-field); aspect-ratio:16/9; } .ds-plate-art { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; height:100%; font-family:var(--font); font-size:.85rem; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(159,231,206,.7); }

components.name: Boundary Row
components.description: Definition row in the safety panel: mint term, dim explanation, one top hairline.
components.css: .ds-boundary { margin:0; font-family:var(--font); } .ds-boundary > div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,4fr) minmax(0,8fr); gap:clamp(10px,2vw,28px); padding:20px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); } .ds-boundary dt { font-weight:600; color:var(--mint); } .ds-boundary dd { margin:0; color:var(--moon-dim); line-height:1.6; }

narrative.overview: The page is an almanac spread read at night: a nocturnal cobalt ground, engraved line work, moon phases and ephemeris rules, and one warm signal colour for anything that asks to be acted on. It is a personal brand surface for reflection content, so it stays calm, slow and editorial rather than promotional. Density is light: generous section rhythm, one idea per section, long-form measures capped at 65ch. The system commits to one theme; the channel and shop sections step up to a cobalt field inside that family instead of flipping to a second theme. Asymmetry carries the personality: a weighted hero split with the plate dropped below the text baseline, a twelve column atlas with uneven spans, and a closing illustration bleeding off the right edge.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (solar coral) reserved for action and focal points, never for decoration.
Geist as the single family across display and body, two weights only (600 / 400-500).
One radius value (14px) on every framed surface and control.
Hairlines instead of shadows: 1px mint-tinted rules organise the page.
Original SVG almanac plates, one per major section, all generated locally.
Motion is a single authored reveal: blur-and-settle on the hero plate, quiet fade-up elsewhere, fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Coral Rule
rules.body: Solar coral appears only where the visitor can act or where an illustration needs one focal point. Never as a section background, never as body text, never as a decorative dot.

rules.name: The One Ground Rule
rules.body: All text sits on ink or a cobalt field from the same family. A light section, a second accent hue, or a warm cream surface is out of system.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: 600 for headings and controls, 400/500 for everything else. No third weight, no italic display, no uppercase eyebrows above headings.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards, plates and panels are flat at rest. No glow, no colored halo, no hard offset shadow.

dos: Do keep solar coral for actions and single focal points only.
Do use 14px on every framed surface and control, without exception.
Do separate sections with one mint hairline and clamp(60px, 9vh, 112px) of padding.
Do set both languages in the self-hosted Geist subset; never add a webfont request.
Do keep entrance motion to the hero plate blur-and-settle plus quiet fade-ups, and disable all of it under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do frame unavailable features as dashed, non-interactive status chips.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue, a light section, or a cream surface.
Don't use shadows, glows, gradient text, or a hard offset shadow for depth.
Don't put an eyebrow or section number above a heading.
Don't write an em dash or en dash anywhere in visible copy.
Don't link to a channel, social account or shop that does not exist yet.
Don't hide content behind an entrance animation that JavaScript might never complete.
